EXTRACT OF DAILY INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY OF MAY 18,1934.

Seizure of pro-communist literature

Acting on the authority of warrants issued at
the instance of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, the
Municipal Police on May 16, 1934, visited two bookstores
located at No.5 Tah Woo Feng (太和坊), Foochow Road, and
136 Honan Road respectively, and seized a small quantity
of pro-communist books at each place.

An application for the disposal of the
seizures was made before court on May 17 when the books
were ordered to be detained in court pending receipt
of a despatch from the Chinese Authorities.
page_data.zh:
1934年5月18日每日情报摘要摘录。

查获亲共文献

依据上海公安局要求签发的搜查令，市政警察于1934年5月16日走访了位于福州路太和坊5号和河南路136号的两家书店，并在两处各查获少量亲共书籍。

5月17日向法庭申请处置查获物品，当时命令将书籍扣押在法院，待收到中国当局函件后再行处理。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. 431）
Date 17.1.1934 34
Subject (in full) Execution of search warrant at the E'h Tsong(合衆) Bookstore,
5 Tah Woo Fong(太和坊), Foochow Road, on 16.5.34.
Made by D.I. Grubb Forwarded by J G Ru. D.I.

With reference to Central Station report dated 16.5.34
regarding the execution of Shanghai Special District Court
Search Warrant No. 2418, at the E'h Tsong(合衆) Bookstore,
5 Tah Woo Fong(太和坊), Foochow Road, on 16.5.34, on behalf
of the Public Safety Bureau, the 36 books seized, entitled
"Time and love in a wrong way"(時代與愛的歧路), are written
by one named Tseng Ts Bing(張資平), who is known as a
proletarian writer. Perusal of the book shows that it contains
nothing of a communistic nature and it deals chiefly with the
extravagance and dissipation of the official and wealthy class.
The manager of the bookstore, named Paung Ka Leong
(方家龍), was absent and the only person on the premises was
an assistant named Loh Yung Tai(陸榮泰).
According to file D.5631 this bookstore was searched
on 17.1.34 when 1333 copies of a pro-communist book entitled
"Liang Sing Sih"(良心集) were seized. The books were
subsequently ordered by the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court
to be confiscated.

（批：嚴禁 8/3）

A Grubb
D. I.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部登记处。431）
日期 1934年1月17日 34
主题（全称） 1934年5月16日对福州路太和坊5号合衆书局执行搜查令。
由 督察 Grubb 制作 经由 J G Ru. 督察转发。

关于中央巡捕房1934年5月16日的报告，涉及代表公安局于1934年5月16日在福州路太和坊5号合衆书局执行上海特区法院第2418号搜查令的情况，查获的36本书籍题为《时代与爱的歧路》，作者名为张资平（Tseng Ts Bing），此人被称为无产阶级作家。查阅该书显示，其中不包含任何共产主义性质的内容，主要讲述官场和富裕阶层的奢侈与放荡。书店经理名为方家龙（Paung Ka Leong），当时不在场，店内仅有一名名为陆荣泰（Loh Yung Tai）的店员。
根据档案 D.5631，该书店曾于1934年1月17日被搜查，当时查获了1333本名为《良心集》（Liang Sing Sih）的亲共书籍。这些书籍随后被江苏高等法院第二分院下令没收。

（批：嚴禁 8/3）

A Grubb

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & B. REGISTRY. 5631 Date January 17th 1924）

Subject (in full) Execution of Warrant No.1067 issued by Judge Dzien
at the request of the Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by W. Ouneau D.S.I.

At 2.45 p.m. January 17, the offices of the Huh
Tsong Book Store, situated at No.545 Foochow Road were visited
in compliance with instruction contained in Warrant No.1067
issued by Judge Dzien at the request of the Public Safety
Bureau. The writ called for the seizure of copies of a
pro-communist book entitled "Liang Sing Sih"; 1333 such books
were found in an upstairs room of the address designated
and were duly removed to Central Police Station. The
impounded literature will be despatched to the 1st Special
District Court on January 18 together with an application
as to its disposal.

The owners of the concern in question are
Chow Wen-ching (周文卿), a salesman of the Zung Chow
Kuo Kwang Zoe (神州國光社), a bookstore on Honan Road,
off Canton Road, and Fang Kya-loong (方家龍) at present
away from Shanghai.

The only person found on the premise at the
time of the raid was Loh Yung-tai (陸榮泰), a shop assistant.

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & B. 登记处。5631 日期 1924年1月17日）

主题（全称） 执行应公安局请求由 Dzien 法官签发的第1067号搜查令。
由 D.S.I. Golder 制作 经由 W. Ouneau D.S.I. 转发。

1月17日下午2时45分，遵照 Dzien 法官应公安局请求签发的第1067号搜查令中的指示，走访了位于福州路545号的合众书局办公室。该令状要求查获一本名为《良心集》（Liang Sing Sih）的亲共书籍；在指定地址的楼上房间发现了1333本此类书籍，并 duly 移送至中央巡捕房。被扣押的文献将于1月18日连同处置申请一并发送至第一特区法院。

该商号的业主为周文卿（Chow Wen-ching），他是位于广东路旁河南路的神州国光社书店的销售员，以及目前不在上海的方家龙（Fang Kya-loong）。

突袭时在现场发现的唯一人员是店员陆荣泰（Loh Yung-tai）。

（批：S.1 / 需要关于 / 逮捕的进一步报告 / M.B.）

Em Golder
D. S. I.

At 2:45p.m. on 17/1/34 D.S.I. Golder of the Special
Branch brought to this station Inspector Koh Lai (柯来)
of the Nantao Public Safety Bureau who requested assis-
tance to execute Search Warrant No.1067 issued by Judge
Dzien at the request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

The Search Warrant was issued against the K'il Tsong
Book Store No.545 Tah Woo Faung off Foochow Road to
search and seize certain pro. Communist inflammatory literature on the
above mentioned premises.

The necessary assistance was given by C.D.S.203 and
1333 copies of the "Liang Sing Zih" were seized from a
room on the 1st floor of 545 Tah Woo Faung.

The seized property will be taken before the S.S.D.
Court on 18/1/34, when an application will be made for
disposal of same.

1934年1月17日下午2时45分，特别处副督察长（D.S.I.）戈尔德（Golder）将南市公共安全局的柯来（Koh Lai）巡官带至本警署，该巡官请求协助执行由上海公共安全局申请、经丁赞（Dzien）法官签发的第1067号搜查令。

该搜查令针对福州路旁大舞坊（Tah Woo Faung）545号的启聪书局（K'il Tsong Book Store），旨在搜查并扣押上述场所内某些亲共煽动性刊物。

中央巡捕房第203号和……号巡捕提供了必要协助，从大舞坊545号一楼的一个房间内查获并扣押了1333份《良声字》（Liang Sing Zih）。

所扣押物品将于1934年1月18日提交特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court），届时将申请予以处置。

副本已送交特别处主管警官。
